questions.text: State the role of a network switch.

answer.text: It forwards frames within a LAN using MAC addresses.
A hardware address identifying a network interface on a local network.

questions.text: State the purpose of an IP address.

answer.text: It identifies a device/interface on an IP network so packets can be routed.
